requirements: R1: The AuthController.mapMoodleRole function must map the 'Аспирант' Moodle role to the internal 'RESEARCHER' role

slices.title: Add 'Аспирант' to Researcher mapping in AuthController
slices.jtbd: When implementing role mapping for this epic, I want 'Аспирант' to correctly map to 'RESEARCHER', so that role synchronization accurately assigns access levels to postgraduate students
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a Moodle role containing 'Аспирант', When mapMoodleRole is evaluated, Then it returns the 'RESEARCHER' internal role.
Given a role mapping unit test, When mapping 'Аспирант', Then the 'RESEARCHER' role mapping is correctly asserted.
